speaker: mysterious_figure
text: *Eyes flare behind the bars. A green finger points.* You. The old ore lift. Is the chain still on the drum? Go. Look. Come back and say.

speaker: mysterious_figure
text: *The eyes tilt, almost pleased. A long finger beckons.* You again. The old miners' ore lift. Is the chain still on the drum? Look for me. Come back and say.

speaker: mysterious_figure
text: *The eyes narrow. The arms withdraw into the dark.* Not you. Not today.

speaker: player
text: I'll look.

speaker: player
text: Not interested.

speaker: mysterious_figure
text: *A finger points the way.* Down the entry hall. Past the gallery. The lift.

speaker: mysterious_figure
text: *The eyes dim.* Then go.

speaker: mysterious_figure
text: *The eyes wait.* The lift. The chain. You have not looked. Go.

speaker: mysterious_figure
text: *Pointed fingers drum the bars.* {days_since} days. Nothing to tell me? Then the work is not done.

speaker: mysterious_figure
text: *A finger lifts.* I asked nothing of you. Yet.

speaker: mysterious_figure
text: *A long pause.* The chain is on the drum. Good. Good. {reward_line}

speaker: mysterious_figure
text: *The eyes brighten.* On the drum, still. You saw it yourself. {reward_line}

speaker: mysterious_figure
text: *The arms go still.* The drum is bare. Gone. Hm. {reward_line}

speaker: mysterious_figure
text: *A hiss through the bars.* Gone from the drum. You are sure. You saw the bare drum. {reward_line}

speaker: mysterious_figure
text: *A green hand pushes something through the bars.* Take this. {reward_item}. Do not ask.

speaker: mysterious_figure
text: *The eyes blink slowly.* You told me already. Day {day}. Enough.

speaker: narration
text: The old ore lift. A heavy chain still hangs from the iron drum, rusted but whole.

speaker: narration
text: The old ore lift. The iron drum is bare. Where the chain hung, only a pale scar of rust is left.

speaker: message_log
text: The figure behind the grate wants to know if the chain is still on the drum of the old ore lift. ({node_name})

speaker: message_log
text: You note it: the chain is still on the drum. Day {day}.

speaker: message_log
text: You note it: the drum is bare, the chain is gone. Day {day}.

text: You told the figure what you saw at the {node_name}.
